title: Martha Bakes
description:
S7 E8 — Pennsylvania Dutch
Montgomery pie; cream cheese-filled pumpkin whoopie pies; apple dumplings; chocolate whoopie pies with vanilla buttercream.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S5 E25 — Applesauce Snack Cake; Selody Sod Farm; Apple Votives
Applesauce snack cake; Melody Sod Farm field trip; apple votives.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E1 — Eggs
Preparing eggs properly, no matter the style; frying eggs; omelet recipe; foolproof frittata.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E2 — Sauces
Two methods for preparing hollandaise sauce; creamy béchamel sauce; serving French sauce beurre blanc over steamed lobster; marinara sauce made with four ingredients.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E3 — Vegetables
Simple vegetable side dishes include steamed spinach, sautéed broccoli rabe, roasted cauliflower steaks, brown sugar-glazed carrots, sautéed sugar snap peas and shelled peas with mint and lemony kale salad.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E4 — Stocks
Three common stocks -- chicken, beef and vegetable.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E5 — Butchering
Master class on meat with fourth-generation butcher Evan Lobel includes cutting up a whole chicken, spatchcocking a Cornish game hen, butterflying a leg of lamb, butchering a beef tenderloin and making medallions from a pork loin.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E8 — Steaming
Cooking chicken breasts in parchment paper; cleaning and steaming mussels; using a bamboo steamer to prepare steamed salmon and peas.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E9 — Roasting
Roast chicken; roasted root vegetable salad; green peppercorn-crusted roast tenderloin of beef.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S8 E12 — Rethinking Cake
A classic roulade made with oat flour and berry cream; gluten-free chocolate buckwheat torte; zucchini-almond cake with cream cheese frosting.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S10 E1 — Adorned Cakes
Three celebration cakes -- a berry chiffon cake, a confection-topped caramel chiffon cake and a woodland stump cake.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S1 E4 — Pound Cake
Variations of the pound cake, from traditional to a version inspired by Asia.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S1 E5 — Puff Pastry
Using buttery pastry for sweet and savory treats such as French napoleon.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S1 E7 — Devil's Food Cake
Martha makes devil's food cake, hi-hat cupcakes, and fudgy brownies on this can't-miss show for chocolate lovers.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S1 E9 — Meringue
Pavlova with passion fruit; île flottante; Huguenot torte.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S1 E10 — Pate Sucree
Traditional lemon mousse damask tart with candied lemon peel; chocolate tart shell layered with homemade caramel and chocolate ganache.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E7 — Hens and Chicks
Now with over 200 chickens and 20 different breeds, Martha shares her vast knowledge about raising and caring for her flock; learn the how-tos of building a coop.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E8 — Martha Builds a Raised Bed Vegetable Garden
Martha builds a brand new, half-acre raised bed vegetable garden on her farm! It's a step-by-step guide to designing, building, preparing the soil, and planting.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E9 — Everything's Coming Up Roses
Everything is coming up roses on Martha's Bedford farm; Martha is creating a brand-new rose garden with almost 200 roses; from color to fragrance, the inspired world of roses is a very good thing.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E10 — Azaleas, Hostas, and Wild Birds
Martha's azalea grove is bursting with the last flowers of spring; then everything you need to know about hostas; Martha takes up bird watching.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E3 — Magic Mushrooms
Martha learns about the magic of mushrooms; mushroom expert Andrew Carter explains each mushroom variety; Martha and mushroom cookbook author Andrea Gentl make delicious mushroom recipes.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E6 — The Bagel Show
Martha samples bagel toppings and is joined by Gary Greengrass, owner of Barney Greengrass, an NYC staple; at PopUp Bagels, Martha makes bagels and constructs breakfast sandwiches with Adam Goldberg.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E8 — Vegan Cuisine Redefined
Martha and Chef Daniel Humm make redefined vegan dishes; Martha and Chef Daniel make a refreshing cocktail and gazpacho, followed by mushroom and seaweed baked rice and a rhubarb cobbler for dessert.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E9 — Authentic Greek Cuisine
Martha and Chef Costas Spiliadis of Estiatorio Milos make Taramasalata and salad; they build an eggplant and zucchini tower with tzatziki; then, they salt-bake a fish served with yogurt.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E8 — Paella on an Open Fire
Martha creates the perfect menu for a paella party that will have your guests coming back for seconds; her paella is served with gazpacho and her incredible sangria.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E4 — Chef David Burke's Modern Classics
Chef David Burke brings his modern classic dishes to Martha's kitchen; a bacon clothesline, calamari noodles, miso chicken with ginger and vegetables, and key lime pie are on the menu.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E6 — Sensational Summer Salads
Martha and Salad Freak author Jess Dameck reveal the art of constructing the perfect salad; Martha and Sarah Carey share a new twist on the classic Caesar salad and create a roasted beet salad.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S1 E19 — Urban Archaeology; Chocolate Curls and Cakes; Potpourri
Urban archaeology; chocolate recipes; potpourri; frozen cookie dough.
